metadata.title: A microfluidic hollow fibre infection model (µHFIM) to monitor bacterial response to dynamic drug treatment with single-cell resolution
metadata.description:
Figures 1-6 as .png and .svg 

Data for figures 2-6 as .opju (Origin pro version 2024/2025, OriginLab Corporation)

Microfluidic device drawings as  *.dwg (AutoCAD, Autodesk GmbH)

Python codes *.py (Python Software Foundation, version 3.12)

Image Analysis

Codes for image analysis and determination of mean intensity + cell occupied area (px)

  • main1.py
  • ND2_Area_Analysis.py   
  • ImageAnalysis.py

Data Processing & Plotting

Codes use output file from image analysis workflow and calculates cell occupied area (from px to µm²) combined with plotting of intensity and area per channel (overview graph, quick check of experiment)

  • Code_sortieren_aufteilen_plotten von outputfileraphsoftware_teil1_v1_file10_batch.py
  • Code_plotting_intensity+areaperchannel_teil2_file11_batch+umrechnungµm2.py

--> Plotting of results from several experiments carried out using Origin

PK Pump-Profile Simulation

Code uses input flow rate and concentration-time input (PK) to generate pumping profiles mimicking the input profile

  • Pumpcode_Serum_PK.py

Growth & Dose Analysis

Codes for calculating AUC, Growth rate (µ) and IC50 for growth experiments and dosing interval experiments (Figures 2, SI2, SI3)

  • AUCnumericintegrationsimpson_3_v241003.py                                              
  • BerechnungIC50,µ_timevscellnumber_v3.py 
  • AUC,µ,IC50_fluorescence-fürgrowthonchip_v3_241011.py

Statistics (Cell Length)

Codes for statistic test (cell length) (Figure 4)

  • cell-length-T-test_v250402.py  
  • cell-length_ttest_Mann-whitney-u-test_wilcoxontest_v250402.py
